name: 5 Times Sit-to-Stand Test
description: Time to complete 5 sit-to-stand repetitions from a standard chair (43–45 cm, armless). Lower time is better.
shirleySays: ICC 0.98 (excellent). MDC: 2.6 s (community elderly). MCID: ~2.3 s. Validated in elderly, OA, TKA/THA, stroke, PD, MS, COPD, cardiac rehab. Measures LE strength, balance, and power. A standard armless chair at 43–45 cm is required.

scoring.mcidNote: ~2.3 s MCID; MDC 2.6 s in community-dwelling elderly
